text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Nunuu~! Didn't reach a perfect score~~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what they truly meant
by the words, "Where there is a will, there is a way."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ha! Could this also just be a stepping stone!?
That only through this defeat can 'where there's a will, there's a way' hold true!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Then there's nothing to do but give it our all!
Full speed ahead until we make it happen!"
